subject: mosque
summary: A pale cream mosque with a large patterned dome rising from the centre of a flat-roofed hall. A smaller patterned dome sits on the right-hand block. Two slender minarets stand on the left and right, each with stacked balconies and a small domed cap. A low arcade of arched openings runs along the left wing. A tall arched portal, recessed and dark, is set in the right front. Small arched windows and doors are set into the plain walls, and a crenellated parapet runs along the roofline.

main_block.where: Central flat-roofed hall, the largest block. The large dome rises from its roof, and the left wing and right block attach to its sides.
main_block.notes: Plain cream walls, flat roof, with the dome rising from its centre.

left_wing.where: Lower block on the left side of the main hall, below the left minaret, with a flat roof.
left_wing.notes: Lower flat-roofed wing, open arcade along its front.

dome.where: Large dome on the roof of the main block, above the centre and left of the right block. Its drum base sits on the parapet.
dome.notes: Ribbed, patterned dome with a finial, on a drum.

small_dome.where: Smaller dome on the right block, sitting above the right-hand flat roof and below the right minaret's base level.
small_dome.notes: Smaller patterned dome on a short drum.

minaret.where: Two slender towers, one on the left front corner and one on the right. The left tower is the taller of the two and rises from a square base; the right one has a smaller square base.
minaret.notes: Slender tapering shaft with a domed lantern cap on top.

dome_drum_windows.where: Ring of small arched openings around the base of the dome drum, below the dome and above the roofline.
dome_drum_windows.notes: Small arched openings set back in the drum base.

minaret_balcony.where: Stacked balcony rings on each minaret shaft, spaced up the tower and below the lantern cap.
minaret_balcony.notes: Projecting balcony rings stacked up each shaft.

minaret_cap.where: Small domed lantern on the top of each minaret, above the highest balcony.
minaret_cap.notes: Small domed lantern cap on top of each minaret.

arcade.where: Row of arched openings along the front of the left wing, under its flat roofline.
arcade.notes: Row of arched openings, open, shallow recess along the front.

portal.where: Tall arched entrance on the right front of the main block, at ground level and rising to about the height of the lower window band.
portal.notes: Tall arched doorway, deep recess, dark wood door.

small_door.where: Small doors at ground level on the lower front wall, beside the arcade and below the window band.
small_door.notes: Small plain doors set into the lower wall.

window.where: Rows of small arched windows on the front walls, in the upper band above the arcade and beside the portal.
window.notes: Small arched windows set back in plain walls.

parapet.where: Low crenellated parapet along the roofline of the main block, between the dome base and the flat roof edge.
parapet.notes: Low crenellated parapet along the roof edge.

front_arcade.where: Row of arched openings along the ground floor of the right front, left of the portal and right of the small doors.
front_arcade.notes: Row of shallow arched recesses along the ground floor, columns between arches.

verify_notes: Missing ground-floor arch row on right front; added as a set-back feature.
